observation.visible_scene: A brightly lit dance studio with a full-height mirrored wall, sheer white curtains on the left, pleated grey curtains behind the mirror, a glossy tiled floor, and rectangular ceiling panel lights. Two women are present, each seen from behind and paired with her own front-facing mirror reflection (the central reflection belongs to the slimmer left dancer; the right-edge reflection belongs to the heavier right dancer). Both wear matching cyan ruffled short-sleeve tops, sparkly magenta mini-skirts, and heeled dance shoes (silver for the left dancer, gold for the right), with hair clips/accessories. The vertical mirror seam and background fixtures stay fixed across all frames, indicating a static camera.
visible_changes: The left dancer's right arm cycles from a low bent position near the waist (frame 1) up to an open-palm wave at head height (frames 3-12), then lowers toward the hips (frames 13-30), then rises again to a raised wave (frames 36-41); her weight shifts between legs and her feet step in and out.

The right dancer's left arm is extended out to the side early (frames 1-3), then both arms move through waving and lowering phases (arms down near hips around frames 13-30), and later her right arm swings outward/forward while her left arm rises (frames 31-41).

The right dancer's footwork changes from one heel lifted behind (frames 1-5) to both feet planted with stepping/crossing (frames 13-30) to a lifted back leg again (frames 36-41); her torso and head rotate slightly, turning her face more to the side in the mirror reflection toward the end.
Skirts flare and settle subtly in sync with the hip and weight movements, and the mirror reflections track these body changes in real time rather than being separate motion.
No camera pan, zoom, or cut is evident; all positional change is body motion of the dancers and their reflections.
outside_clip_unknowns: The beginning and end of the dance routine (the segment is cropped mid-motion at both ends), the accompanying music or rhythm, and any steps before frame 1 or after frame 41.
Whether the two dancers are following the same choreography in unison or performing independently; the clip shows similar but not identical arm/leg phases.
uncertain_details: Exact footwear type and whether the 'reflections' are purely mirror images or include a second real person is inferred from geometry (matching poses and the mirror seam), not directly labeled.
Precise dance style/name and the intended arm pattern are not identifiable from the frames alone.
